surfacelight.config.title: Surface Light
surfacelight.config.serverControlled: Controlled by the server: these values are read-only while you are connected.
surfacelight.config.enabled.tooltip: Master switch. When off, sky light is completely vanilla.
surfacelight.config.currentPhase.unknown: Current moon phase: join a world to see it
surfacelight.config.preset.tooltip: A ready-made set of per-phase night light levels. Choose Custom to set each phase yourself with the sliders below.
surfacelight.config.preset.full_moon_res: Full Moon Respite (only full is safe)
surfacelight.config.moon.tooltip: Night sky light level for this moon phase. 0 = darkest, 15 = full daylight. Vanilla is 4. At 8+ no mobs spawn on the surface.
surfacelight.config.thunder.tooltip: Extra darkness during a night thunderstorm. 0 = off.
